entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: Massive city-stronghold on Mirrodin and capital of the Vedalken Empire, later capital of Jin-Gitaxias's Progress Engine.

entities.name: Synod
entities.description: Gathering of vedalken rulers and officials housed at Lumengrid.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: People from the coast of the Quicksilver Sea, used as labor and slaves by the vedalken.

entities.name: Battle of the Synod
entities.description: Battle in which the Neurok disabled vedalken defenses.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Phyrexian whose Progress Engine made Lumengrid its capital.

events.summary: At the Battle of the Synod the Neurok disable vedalken defenses, leaving hundreds dead including vedalken leadership.
events.quote: the Neurok were able to disable vedalken defenses at Lumengrid, leading to a massive battle

events.summary: The two cultures enter an uneasy truce, vedalken in the upper city and Neurok in the lower.
events.quote: the two cultures entered an uneasy truce, in which both inhabited Lumengrid.

events.summary: After the Phyrexianization of the plane, Lumengrid becomes capital of Jin-Gitaxias's Progress Engine.
events.quote: Lumengrid became the capital of Jin-Gitaxias Progress Engine.

relations.quote: was a massive city-stronghold on Mirrodin , and the capital of the Vedalken Empire.

relations.note: brought as lab workers and slaves
